newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet fuel tumbles with NYMEX, diffs hold.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet fuel tumbles with NYMEX, diffs hold.

text.p: U.S. spot prompt jet fuel prices tumbled with NYMEX August heating oil futures on Thursday, but differentials held in thin trade ahead of the three-day Fourth of July weekend, traders said.
NYMEX heating oil futures fell 2.16 cents a gallon, to 52.76 cents, in sympathy with lower crude amid indications Iraq would soon resume sales of crude oil.
U.S. prompt 54-grade jet fuel was bid at even with August futures, stable with Wednesday differentials, traders said, while New York material also held steady at 2.35 cents over the July print.
The NYMEX closed early at 1300 EDT (1700 GMT) Thursday and will be closed Friday for the holiday.
